questions.evidence:
[Challenge rule] A badge requires at least twenty active reading minutes on each of three different days in one week. Short periods on the same day may be added. Breaks and book selection do not count, and surplus minutes cannot be moved to another day.

[Mara's log] Monday: twelve minutes before class and nine afterward. Tuesday: thirty minutes in the library, including eight minutes choosing books and four minutes chatting. Thursday: twenty-five minutes of reading. Friday: twenty minutes of reading.

[Mara's comment] I spent the longest library period there on Tuesday, so that must be my strongest day. [Teacher] Library time and active reading time are different. Count the relevant minutes before judging whether the target was reached.

Mara checks the entries and keeps all of them, including the day below target. Her badge records consistent participation across enough days. It does not show that she reads faster than classmates, understands every page, or can predict a future exam result from minutes alone.
